title: Nashville's Premier Bourbon and Whiskey Tour by Van
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age to participate is 21 years old
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: So, you like whiskey and bourbon? You've taken other tours and want to dive deeper into and broaden your knowledge of whiskey and bourbon? This is the tour for you. This 4 hour elevated experience with put you in a small group setting with experienced whiskey stewards and distillers. You will get samples directly from barrels, see how the distillers test barrels for quality & readiness for harvesting. You may even get to sample whiskey or bourbon not yet available to the public. Furthermore, you will learn how to pair whiskey with foods and have a much deeper understanding and appreciation for your favorite whiskey and bourbon. While you are on this excursion, you will visit 3 of the best locations in Nashville!
